{{Wireless adapter |brand=TP-LINK |model=TL-WN550G |revision= |upc= |ean= |asin= |price= |est_release_date= |fcc_date=08/08/2005 |manuf_country=China |manuf= |manuf_model= |manuf_rev= |if=PCI |vendor_id= |device_id= |subvendor_id= |subdevice_id= |fcc_id=TE7WN55XG |ic_id= |chip1_brand=Atheros |chip1_model=AR2413 |chip2_brand= |chip2_model= |chip3_brand= |chip3_model= |flags= |ant_conn= |802dot11_protocols=bg |txchains= |rxchains= |sstreams= |oui= |lin_driver= |win_driver= }} ''54M Wireless PCI Adapter'', '''eXtended Range'''
This device is using an '''Atheros''' single chip radio.. assumed to be AR2413
The FCC photos show the device with an RP-SMA connector, but some units may have only integral antennas.
Per the FCC test report, this device was also branded under the Turbocomm and IPLINK names.
May also be known as the [[JensenScandinavia AL7354]]
